title: Les Mis\'erables Dialogue: A film-based network representation of social communication
abstract: arXiv:2610.13148v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work, we revisit the classic Les Mis\'erables benchmark network from the perspective of social communication. Using the 1998 film adaptation of the novel, we construct the publicly available Les Mis\'erables Dialogue temporal text network, which explicitly distinguishes speakers, addressees, and other recipients of each utterance, along with its content and timing. Using the ten social dimensions model, we also derive multilayer network representations of the network, in which layers correspond to distinct relational dimensions. Beyond the network dataset, this work offers a general methodology for building similarly rich communication datasets from similar narrative sources.

translated_title: 《悲惨世界对话：基于电影的社会交流网络表示》
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们从社会交流的视角重新审视了经典的《悲惨世界》基准网络。利用1998年该小说的电影改编版本，我们构建了公开可用的《悲惨世界对话》时序文本网络，该网络明确区分了每句台词的说话者、受话者及其他接收者，并包含台词的内容与时间信息。利用十维社会关系模型，我们还推导出该网络的多层网络表示，其中各层对应不同的关系维度。除网络数据集本身之外，本工作还提供了一种通用方法论，可用于从类似的叙事素材中构建同样丰富的交流数据集。
tldr: 本工作基于1998年电影版《悲惨世界》构建了公开可用的时序文本网络数据集，明确区分每句台词的说话者、受话者、内容与时间，并通过十维社会关系模型给出多层网络表示，同时提供了从叙事素材构建丰富交流数据集的通用方法。
en_tdlr: This work constructs a publicly available temporal text network from the 1998 film adaptation of Les Misérables—explicitly distinguishing speakers, addressees, content, and timing of each utterance—derives multilayer representations via the ten social dimensions model, and offers a general methodology for building similarly rich communication datasets from narrative sources.
